statement.excerpt: Both companies lose billions of dollars, both companies have no path to profitability, and both companies sell products — both to consumers and businesses — that simply do not work when users are forced to pay something approaching a sustainable cost.
statement.document_title: The Subprime AI Crisis Is Here

from_speaker: Both companies lose billions of dollars
both companies have no path to profitability
do not work when users are forced to pay something approaching a sustainable cost
our_interpretation: The companies are Anthropic and OpenAI. Each must satisfy the financial assertion separately.

For ongoing annual losses, I use calendar 2025, the latest completed year before publication. The commercial-viability assertions describe the position on March 31, 2026. The target interval accommodates these two components.
I read billions as at least $2 billion per company, and losses as company-wide net losses. The speaker does not identify an accounting basis, so the contract records it as unknown.
The ordinary reading of sustainable cost is pricing that covers delivering the service and maintaining the business, including recurring development and overhead.

Products do not work at that price means customers cannot obtain commercially useful service at a price sufficient to sustain the supplier. It does not mean that every individual output is technically defective.
No path to profitability means no credible commercial route existed at publication. Current losses alone cannot establish that stronger assertion.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable annual results establish multibillion-dollar losses at each company, and credible cost, pricing, retention, and operating evidence establishes the asserted lack of a viable business model for both.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable results refute the loss assertion for either company, or evidence applicable at publication establishes a credible profitable business model or commercially useful service with retained demand at fully cost-covering prices.
